company.shortDescription: Fasset is a digital banking and financial platform offering interest-free saving, investing, spending, and money transfer services.
company.description: Fasset is a digital banking and financial platform offering interest-free saving, investing, spending, and money transfer services. Its platform provides multi-currency accounts, global debit cards, instant settlements, and access to investments in crypto, stocks, funds, and commodities. Fasset also offers business banking, API services, and over-the-counter trading solutions, with infrastructure powered by blockchain technology.
